description: This file provides core configuration utilities for a backend service, including loading environment variables, defining an immutable configuration class, and exposing configuration accessors. It centralizes environment-based settings such as content root directory and cache TTL, and attempts to load environment variables from a .env file if available.

classes.name: AppConfig
classes.description: Immutable data class representing application configuration with content root and cache TTL, loaded from environment variables.

methods.name: "AppConfig" from_env( default_content_root: str = "./data/content", default_cache_ttl: int = 60 * 60 * 24, )
methods.description: Static method to create an AppConfig instance by reading environment variables, with default values if not set.
